resolution_method: figshare API /v2/articles/search then /v2/articles/{id}; depmap.org bot interstitial avoided. ndownloader redirects to s3-eu-west-1.amazonaws.com (network grant required).
positive_control_note: POLR2A is absent from the 24Q4 CRISPRGeneEffect matrix; POLR2B and POLR2D substituted and reported.
expression_vs_dependency_statement: None of the 81 floor-passing receptor subunits shows a compatibility-correlated dependency (0 significant at FDR<0.05; 3 nominal). No WNT receptor is a dependency in any lineage (pan-lineage mean gene effect from LRP5 -0.163 to FZD6 +0.146; most negative single lineage cell FZD5 -0.317 in Pancreas), and NPR1 (receptor for the two highest-availability ligands NPPA/NPPB) has pan-lineage mean -0.163. The receptors that ARE dependencies (NCL, ITGAV, EGFR, ITGB5, ITGB1, ERBB2, FGFR1, IGF1R) are pan-essential or adhesion/RTK genes whose essentiality is lineage-driven and unrelated to HF ligand availability. Therefore the nominated axes are candidate signalling conduits, NOT drug targets: receptor expression licenses a cell to receive a secreted signal, but loss-of-function does not impair proliferation in vitro, so these receptors should be tested by ligand stimulation / pathway-reporter readout, not by viability knockout screens.
lineage_mapping_caveats: 22 of 30 DepMap lineages mapped; 29 of 30 TCGA types covered. ACC (adrenocortical, double-centered rank 1) has only 1 CRISPR-screened DepMap adrenal line, below min_lines=5, so the top double-centered type is untestable. Lymphoid/Myeloid unmapped (LAML/DLBC already excluded upstream); Bone has no TCGA cohort. Low-confidence: PNS<->PCPG (neuroblastoma vs pheochromocytoma). Medium: Soft Tissue<->SARC (histology mismatch), Thyroid<->THCA (anaplastic lines vs papillary tumors), Eye<->UVM (retinoblastoma contamination). UCS and UCEC share one DepMap Uterus lineage, so the top-ranked type cannot be resolved from UCEC in DepMap.
